# Identifier and literal quoting, qualified names and placeholders per dialect.
# Written by sqlgen::golden from the core code; never edited by hand.

## postgres
quote_ident "users" => "\"users\""
quote_ident "Order Items" => "\"Order Items\""
quote_ident "a\"b" => "\"a\"\"b\""
quote_ident "a`b" => "\"a`b\""
quote_ident "a]b" => "\"a]b\""
quote_ident "x\"; DROP TABLE t; --" => "\"x\"\"; DROP TABLE t; --\""
quote_ident "select" => "\"select\""
quote_ident "ünïcode" => "\"ünïcode\""
quote_ident "" => "\"\""
quote_ident "tab\tline\nbreak" => "\"tab\tline\nbreak\""
qualify "app" "users" => "\"app\".\"users\""
qualify "" "users" => "\"users\""
qualify null "users" => "\"users\""
qualify "users" "t" => "\"users\".\"t\""
qualify "app" "Order Items" => "\"app\".\"Order Items\""
qualify "" "Order Items" => "\"Order Items\""
qualify null "Order Items" => "\"Order Items\""
qualify "Order Items" "t" => "\"Order Items\".\"t\""
qualify "app" "a\"b" => "\"app\".\"a\"\"b\""
qualify "" "a\"b" => "\"a\"\"b\""
qualify null "a\"b" => "\"a\"\"b\""
qualify "a\"b" "t" => "\"a\"\"b\".\"t\""
qualify "app" "a`b" => "\"app\".\"a`b\""
qualify "" "a`b" => "\"a`b\""
qualify null "a`b" => "\"a`b\""
qualify "a`b" "t" => "\"a`b\".\"t\""
qualify "app" "a]b" => "\"app\".\"a]b\""
qualify "" "a]b" => "\"a]b\""
qualify null "a]b" => "\"a]b\""
qualify "a]b" "t" => "\"a]b\".\"t\""
qualify "app" "x\"; DROP TABLE t; --" => "\"app\".\"x\"\"; DROP TABLE t; --\""
qualify "" "x\"; DROP TABLE t; --" => "\"x\"\"; DROP TABLE t; --\""
qualify null "x\"; DROP TABLE t; --" => "\"x\"\"; DROP TABLE t; --\""
qualify "x\"; DROP TABLE t; --" "t" => "\"x\"\"; DROP TABLE t; --\".\"t\""
qualify "app" "select" => "\"app\".\"select\""
qualify "" "select" => "\"select\""
qualify null "select" => "\"select\""
qualify "select" "t" => "\"select\".\"t\""
qualify "app" "ünïcode" => "\"app\".\"ünïcode\""
qualify "" "ünïcode" => "\"ünïcode\""
qualify null "ünïcode" => "\"ünïcode\""
qualify "ünïcode" "t" => "\"ünïcode\".\"t\""
qualify "app" "" => "\"app\".\"\""
qualify "" "" => "\"\""
qualify null "" => "\"\""
qualify "" "t" => "\"t\""
qualify "app" "tab\tline\nbreak" => "\"app\".\"tab\tline\nbreak\""
qualify "" "tab\tline\nbreak" => "\"tab\tline\nbreak\""
qualify null "tab\tline\nbreak" => "\"tab\tline\nbreak\""
qualify "tab\tline\nbreak" "t" => "\"tab\tline\nbreak\".\"t\""
quote_literal "it's" => "'it''s'"
quote_literal_with BackslashEscapes "it's" => "'it''s'"
quote_literal_with NoBackslashEscapes "it's" => "'it''s'"
quote_literal "a\\b" => "'a\\b'"
quote_literal_with BackslashEscapes "a\\b" => "E'a\\\\b'"
quote_literal_with NoBackslashEscapes "a\\b" => "E'a\\\\b'"

quote_literal_with BackslashEscapes "C:\\it's" => "E'C:\\\\it''s'"
quote_literal_with NoBackslashEscapes "C:\\it's" => "E'C:\\\\it''s'"

quote_literal_with NoBackslashEscapes "it's a\\b" => "E'it''s a\\\\b'"
quote_literal "a\\" => "'a\\'"
quote_literal_with BackslashEscapes "a\\" => "E'a\\\\'"
quote_literal_with NoBackslashEscapes "a\\" => "E'a\\\\'"
quote_literal "a\\'" => "'a\\'''"
quote_literal_with BackslashEscapes "a\\'" => "E'a\\\\'''"
quote_literal_with NoBackslashEscapes "a\\'" => "E'a\\\\'''"
quote_literal "a\u0000b" => "'a\u0000b'"
quote_literal_with BackslashEscapes "a\u0000b" => "'a\u0000b'"
quote_literal_with NoBackslashEscapes "a\u0000b" => "'a\u0000b'"

quote_literal_with NoBackslashEscapes "say \"hi\"" => "'say \"hi\"'"
quote_literal "héllo" => "'héllo'"

## mysql
quote_ident "users" => "`users`"
quote_ident "Order Items" => "`Order Items`"
quote_ident "a\"b" => "`a\"b`"
quote_ident "a`b" => "`a``b`"
quote_ident "a]b" => "`a]b`"
quote_ident "x\"; DROP TABLE t; --" => "`x\"; DROP TABLE t; --`"
quote_ident "select" => "`select`"
quote_ident "ünïcode" => "`ünïcode`"
quote_ident "" => "``"
quote_ident "tab\tline\nbreak" => "`tab\tline\nbreak`"
qualify "app" "users" => "`app`.`users`"
qualify "" "users" => "`users`"
qualify null "users" => "`users`"
qualify "users" "t" => "`users`.`t`"
qualify "app" "Order Items" => "`app`.`Order Items`"
qualify "" "Order Items" => "`Order Items`"
qualify null "Order Items" => "`Order Items`"
qualify "Order Items" "t" => "`Order Items`.`t`"
qualify "app" "a\"b" => "`app`.`a\"b`"
qualify "" "a\"b" => "`a\"b`"
qualify null "a\"b" => "`a\"b`"
qualify "a\"b" "t" => "`a\"b`.`t`"
qualify "app" "a`b" => "`app`.`a``b`"
qualify "" "a`b" => "`a``b`"
qualify null "a`b" => "`a``b`"
qualify "a`b" "t" => "`a``b`.`t`"
qualify "app" "a]b" => "`app`.`a]b`"
qualify "" "a]b" => "`a]b`"
qualify null "a]b" => "`a]b`"
qualify "a]b" "t" => "`a]b`.`t`"
qualify "app" "x\"; DROP TABLE t; --" => "`app`.`x\"; DROP TABLE t; --`"
qualify "" "x\"; DROP TABLE t; --" => "`x\"; DROP TABLE t; --`"
qualify null "x\"; DROP TABLE t; --" => "`x\"; DROP TABLE t; --`"
qualify "x\"; DROP TABLE t; --" "t" => "`x\"; DROP TABLE t; --`.`t`"
qualify "app" "select" => "`app`.`select`"
qualify "" "select" => "`select`"
qualify null "select" => "`select`"
qualify "select" "t" => "`select`.`t`"
qualify "app" "ünïcode" => "`app`.`ünïcode`"
qualify "" "ünïcode" => "`ünïcode`"
qualify null "ünïcode" => "`ünïcode`"
qualify "ünïcode" "t" => "`ünïcode`.`t`"
qualify "app" "" => "`app`.``"
qualify "" "" => "``"
qualify null "" => "``"
qualify "" "t" => "`t`"
qualify "app" "tab\tline\nbreak" => "`app`.`tab\tline\nbreak`"
qualify "" "tab\tline\nbreak" => "`tab\tline\nbreak`"
qualify null "tab\tline\nbreak" => "`tab\tline\nbreak`"
qualify "tab\tline\nbreak" "t" => "`tab\tline\nbreak`.`t`"
quote_literal "it's" => "'it\\'s'"
quote_literal_with BackslashEscapes "it's" => "'it''s'"
quote_literal_with NoBackslashEscapes "it's" => "'it''s'"
quote_literal "a\\b" => "'a\\\\b'"

quote_literal_with NoBackslashEscapes "a\\b" => "'a\\b'"

quote_literal_with BackslashEscapes "C:\\it's" => "'C:\\\\it''s'"
quote_literal_with NoBackslashEscapes "C:\\it's" => "'C:\\it''s'"

quote_literal_with NoBackslashEscapes "a\\" => "'a\\'"
quote_literal "a\\'" => "'a\\\\\\''"
quote_literal_with BackslashEscapes "a\\'" => "'a\\\\'''"
quote_literal_with NoBackslashEscapes "a\\'" => "'a\\'''"
quote_literal "a\u0000b" => "'a\\0b'"
quote_literal_with BackslashEscapes "a\u0000b" => "'a\\0b'"
quote_literal_with NoBackslashEscapes "a\u0000b" => "'a\u0000b'"

quote_literal_with BackslashEscapes "say \"hi\"" => "'say \"hi\"'"
quote_literal_with NoBackslashEscapes "say \"hi\"" => "'say \"hi\"'"
